snippet.title: Surviving Ceres - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Surviving Ceres is my next game in development slated to release in 2025.

Surviving Ceres is an open-world survival game emphasizing crafting and base building, exporting rare materials and manufactured goods to earn funding used to unlock new technologies and upgrades. Bring in colonists from Earth to work advanced facilities to terraform the planet.  Defend your base from hostile aliens, and eventually take the fight to them in an effort to make Ceres a safe terraformed paradise for humanity. 

Please Wish List the game on Steam or try the demo today.  If you want to have a deeper connection to the game's development or play in the early beta Join my discord or other socials.
